key_idea: Give all passwords the same length so only substitutions matter, then add a checksum character so any two differ in at least two positions.
sketch: Each password is the fixed prefix 'aA!x' (covers lowercase, uppercase, special) followed by three decimal digits of the index and a fourth digit equal to their sum mod 10. Equal lengths mean edit distance 1 could only be a single substitution; two different indices differing in exactly one digit also differ in the checksum, so Hamming distance is at least 2. Exactly 1000 codewords, O(n) output. Any valid list is accepted so the token checker cannot judge it; my own validator confirmed for n=1000 the length, the four character classes, distinctness and pairwise Hamming distance >=2.
